tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All other terms & conditions are as per tender documents.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Original Vehicle manufacturers of heavy passenger vehicles such as TATA, Leyland, Eicher, Volvo, Scania, Corona, Olectra, JBM etc are eligible to participate in the tender or Suppliers to (Suppliers to OVMs means who are supplier of ADAS to OVMs of heavy passenger vehicles such as TATA, Leyland, Eicher, Volvo, Scania, Corona, Olectra, JBM etc are eligible to participate in the tender. Or Manufacturer of Advanced Driver Assistance System Should have minimum average annual turnover of Rs. 03 Crore for preceding three years are eligible to participate in the tender.Should have experience in the execution of Advanced Driver Assistance System (ADAS) with a minimum of at least 100 vehicles for any Central Govt. / State Govt. / PSU/ Private Organization in the last 3 financial year i.e 2023-24, 2024-2025, 2025-2026.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- SUBMIT THE DOCUMENTS AS PER THE PREQUALIFICATION CRITERIA OF THE TENDER.

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Additional format with list of items
Certification of Verification issued by the Chartered Accountant in the format prescribed
Compliance to Certification & Specification as mentioned in Tender-Annexure-c
Declaration form as per the format
In case of Manufacturers, they should submit the Certificate of Incorporation/ SSI Certificate / Registration Certificate issued by the Registrar of Companies /Industries and Commerce Dept.

In Case of Supplier To OVMs for ADAS they should submit Purchase orders or Schedule Agreements or Work Orders released BY Original vehicle manufacturers such as TATA, LEYLAND, EICHER, VOLVO, SCANIA, CORONA, OLECTRA, JBM etc in any one year in the last three financial year including the current year i.e 2024-25/2025-26/2026-27 or valid as on closing date of tender.
NSIC certificate-To avail exemption from the payment of Tender form Fee and Earnest Money Deposit
